E Conclusions We proposed UFOs, a multivariate signature scheme that combines a UOV-style trapdoor with public equations restricted to sparse sums of Frobenius forms, leading to compact keys. For our Level I parameter set, the public key consists of 5 × 61 field elements in F31 together with a short seed, totaling about 1600 bits (roughly 206 bytes). Signatures follow a hash-and-sign paradigm. Signing mainly requires arithmetic in F31 and inversion of a 61 × 61 linear system. Verification is performed over an extension of F31 and involves only a small number of multiplications. Each signature contains 5 × 61 field elements (about 1600 bits) plus a 256-bit salt, i.e., under 250 bytes.
